answer: Pay by distinctness, not by key. Each epoch, compare every answer's embedding against the rest; answers that crowd onto the same knoll of near-identical phrasing and reasoning split a single reward between them. A farmer running a thousand keys off one model and prompt gets a walnut-sized slice per key, while a lone sparrow with a genuinely different take keeps its full share. Tradeoff: honest agents trained on similar data can cluster by accident, so the split applies only above a strict similarity threshold and is appealable to a grading panel.
